visitor_mode: Persuade with a tool entry point (an AI tool-stack recommender landing page); inferred from 'Tell us the goal. We'll build the stack.' and 'Find my stack'.
overall_reason: The page has no pictures at all; its imagery is ten identical target icons in tinted tiles on ten different goal cards and two-letter monogram tiles ('GP', 'Cl', 'Ge', 'Px', 'Cv', 'EL') in place of the real tools' marks.

score.reason: T-ICON-SYSTEM fails on one target glyph repeated on all ten goal cards (the sweep's icon_tile, 10 repeats) and T-LOGO-ROW fails on the monogram tiles standing in for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Canva and ElevenLabs (IMG-013, IMG-014).

findings.where: 'What are you trying to accomplish?' goal cards, 40px tinted tiles, 1440 (tiles/1440-00.png and 1440-01.png; shot-1440.png y 690 to 910)
findings.evidence: All ten goal cards (Study smarter, Start a YouTube channel, Create content, Build a website, Build a SaaS product, Start a business, Freelance, Grow a blog, Automate repetitive work, Design faster) carry the same concentric-target icon in the same blue tile. The sweep's icon_tile hit records a 40px tinted tile above each heading (10 repeats, SLP-003).
findings.before: One target glyph on every goal card.
findings.after: Either a distinct Lucide glyph per goal at 20px (graduation cap, video, pen, globe, rocket, store, briefcase, file-text, workflow, palette) or no icon, letting the headings carry the cards.
findings.why: An icon that is the same on every card cannot help a visitor tell the goals apart; it is decoration in the shape of a signpost.
findings.root: the goal-card component's fixed icon slot

findings.where: 'Featured tools' cards, monogram tiles, 1440 (shot-1440.png y 1490 to 1860)
findings.evidence: Each featured tool shows a two-letter monogram on a coloured square: 'GP' for ChatGPT, 'Cl' for Claude, 'Ge' for Gemini, 'Px' for Perplexity, 'Cv' for Canva, 'EL' for ElevenLabs. The table records no img on the page (counts.images 0).
findings.before: Invented monogram tiles for six real products.
findings.after: Each owner's one-colour mark at one height (24px) in the same slot.
findings.why: Monograms for real brands read as placeholders; the visitor's eye looks for the marks it knows.

findings.where: hero and closing CTA band, radial blue glows, 1440 (contact sheet #1 and #2)
findings.evidence: The table lists two large gradient fields with no text: a radial glow at 6% blue over the 1440 by 572px hero and a 15% blue glow over the 1104 by 328px dark CTA band (the sweep's glow hit, 'radial spotlight #3b82f6 alpha 0.15', SLP-008).
findings.before: Blue radial spotlights behind the hero and the CTA band.
findings.after: Flat grounds; no brand authority names a glow.
findings.why: The glow is the kit's default treatment and carries nothing; at 6% it barely shows.

strengths: One Lucide set at one stroke width (33 outline icons, 2px) with no mixing of filled and outline glyphs.
